data.content: # Celtic vs Celta Vigo Prediction: Celta Vigo to Edge Celtic in a Game With Goals. ## Celtic vs Celta Vigo: Prediction for the match on October 22, 2026. Celtic arrive off a 7-1 Premiership win over Heart of Midlothian, and their last European meeting with Celta Vigo was a far tighter affair. In 2002-03 Celtic won the first leg 1-0 at Parkhead, but Celta took the return 2-1 in Vigo, so nobody should expect a comfortable night in Glasgow. Callum Osmand scored twice in his first start for Celtic, and the 7-1 rout of Hearts on 18 October is the one result in this stretch that does not read like a warning. Across those five games Celtic have scored 11 and conceded 9, averages of 2.2 and 1.8 a match, with one clean sheet and one game without a goal. With Celta Vigo arriving on a Thursday night, the number I keep returning to is that two of their three home games in this run ended in defeat.
